purpose: diagnosis only; no production fix or performance claim
prior_results: Actual search scanned307, partial=true,25 missing-record errors; five lexical hits unrelated corpus adoption/math and no matching publication-interleave result. U3 is documents-only Linux no-replace, not portable ingest evidence. PY39-INGEST newline and scope tests do not exercise final publication window. No result reused as acceptance.
method: Four isolated temporary minimal-corpus unittest cases: ordinary success, dependency removal during final private copy, empty concurrent target immediately before rename, nonempty target control. Deterministic same-process interposition, not scheduler coverage or hostile filesystem proof. Intended refusal/preservation assertions can fail; save full logs and observations.
acceptance: No requirement baseline passes. Classify confirmed only if hook executes and observations show canonical mutation/success/invalid closure or changed target inode, independently reviewed. Keep both passing controls and all failures. No new defect inference from old titles.
risks: No real corpus writes; no models/backends/CLI installs, full suites or exhausted branches. Platform-dependent POSIX empty target evidence limited to actual Linux. No portable fix yet: existing documents helper is Linux-only and replacing import with it would remove supported portable behavior.
runtime_boundary: Descriptive offline DAG. No authenticated ReviewSession/ManagedEngine/verifier installed; stored evidence cannot authorize runtime reuse.
